title: Fermionic entanglement and quantum correlation measures in molecules
summary: We analyze fermionic entanglement and correlation measures in the ground and the low temperature thermal state of the water molecule as a function of the internuclear distance in the context of the full configuration interaction approach. The aim is to obtain a general entanglement based characterization of the electronic eigenstates. We consider first the spin-up - spin-down partition and the associated Schmidt decomposition, examining the total up-down entanglement of the electronic wave function.
